rows.label: tlk502105_msg0002
rows.name: Hey! Do you like that tree?

rows.label: tlk502105_msg0012
rows.name:
Invidia's scenery is beautiful, right?
You'd never see anything like it in
other countries.

rows.label: tlk502105_msg0013
rows.name:
If you're feeling messed-up
inside, looking at nice scenery
makes you feel much better.

rows.label: tlk502105_msg0015
rows.name:
Making a living as a mercenary in the
Invidian army isn't easy.

rows.label: tlk502105_msg0016
rows.name:
We're treated worse than regular
soldiers, and often given expendable
missions on the battlefield.

rows.label: tlk502105_msg0018
rows.name:
The pay for one job is large,
but there is no allowance
when you get injured.

rows.label: tlk502105_msg0019
rows.name:
A serious injury can leave you unable
to work for months, so sometimes it's
not worth it...

rows.label: tlk502105_msg0021
rows.name:
So sometimes, after a job, I come
and just have a look at the Invidian
landscape. Really heals me.

rows.label: tlk502105_msg0022
rows.name:
Having you listen today made me feel
even more refreshed than usual.

rows.label: tlk502105_msg0023
rows.name:
Thanks. I bought this for my parent,
but you can have it.

rows.label: tlk502105_msg0033
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Think ] Seems to really like nature...
